title: Compact GEC with FLAN-T5-small: code, splits, outputs and analyses
description: Code, configurations, data splits, system outputs and analysis results for 'Rethinking FLAN-T5 for Grammatical Error Correction: Controlled Baselines, Full-Budget Ablations and Two-Stage Transfer with Little Human Data' (M. A. ElTaweel and N. Negied). Includes the Kaggle notebooks, the C4-200M split indices, the W&I+LOCNESS stage-2 holdout indices, all system outputs as scored, official-scorer results with paired bootstraps, and a portable verification script.
